title: Real-money venue-vs-computed P&L gaps: each gap or venue_unmatched row is its own diagnosis item (operator w11)
clears_when: scripts/ops/venue_pnl_gaps.py --mode real --max-age-days 7 --check exits 0 (no real-money gap or unmatched item closed in the last 7 days without its own diagnosis item)
note: Created 2026-11-12 by lane JOURNAL-TRUTH on manager decision (#25270): for REAL-MONEY accounts (bybit_2, alpaca_live, ib_live) every gap above tolerance (max 0.25 USD, 1%) and every venue_unmatched row gets ITS OWN diagnosis item. Whoever works this row files each VPG item as its own pipeline item with the diagnosis; this row is the owner of that intake, not a bucket. Nothing is populated until #25270 is merged and deployed.
